parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339 instant, inclusive. Defaults to `to` minus 30 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339 instant, exclusive. Defaults to now. At most 366 days after `from`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Narrows every counter to one site. Omitted = every site.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: The time-bucket resolution; only `day` exists (the default).
